waivers.reason: CVE-2023-30533 (prototype pollution when READING a forged file). xlsx 0.18.5 is the latest version on npm; the fix (>=0.19.3) only exists in the official SheetJS distribution (cdn.sheetjs.com), outside the registry. Renewed on 2026-09-30 with exploitability removed: every untrusted spreadsheet read runs isolated — in the API in a disposable worker thread (apps/api/src/modules/reports/import/xlsx-isolated-reader.ts, via core/security/disposable-worker.ts: own V8 realm, empty env, 10 s deadline, only cloned data comes back); in the web app in a Web Worker (apps/web/src/shared/lib/xlsx-isolated.ts + xlsx-read.worker.ts). A polluted prototype dies with the worker and does not reach the process/page. Spreadsheet writing (export) is not affected by the advisory.
waivers.evidence: Tests: disposable-worker.spec.ts (pollution in the worker does not reach the process; empty env), import-parser.service.spec.ts ('runs SheetJS in another realm' fails if parsing goes back in-process), xlsx-isolated.test.ts (worker terminated, bytes transferred) and the guards dependency-waiver-reachability.spec.ts / xlsx-isolated.test.ts (XLSX.read only inside the worker). Web worker validated in real Chromium.
waivers.closeCondition: Install SheetJS CE >= 0.20.3 from the official distribution (https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz, integrity pinned in the lockfile) in apps/api and apps/web, with the import/export suites green — blocked on 2026-09-30 only because the development environment egress denies cdn.sheetjs.com; or replace the library. Keep the isolation until then.

waivers.reason: CVE-2024-22363 (ReDoS when reading). Same root cause as advisory 1108110 (fix >=0.20.2 only outside npm). Renewed on 2026-09-30 with exploitability removed: the isolated parse has a deadline (API 10 s, web 15 s) and the worker is terminated — runaway CPU blocks neither the API event loop nor the UI.
waivers.evidence: disposable-worker.spec.ts ('terminates runaway CPU at the deadline while this event loop keeps running'), import-parser.service.spec.ts (deadline -> PT-BR user-facing rejection, technical cause only in the log; event loop free during the parse), xlsx-isolated.test.ts (worker terminated at the deadline). Since 2026-09-30 API parses are also limited per process (core/security/concurrency-limiter.ts: 2 active, 4 queued, 2 per tenant; the excess receives 503 IMPORT_PARSER_BUSY): 32 simultaneous uploads at the size ceiling stayed at 516 MB RSS and 0 timeouts (before: 3.4 GB and all timed out).

waivers.reason: CVE-2026-35515 (SSE field injection in SseStream._transform). Fix only in @nestjs/core >= 11.1.18; 10.4.22 is the last 10.x (no backport). Not reachable: the SSE path of @nestjs/core is only activated for handlers with SSE_METADATA ('__sse__'), set only by @Sse(); the API has no @Sse handler, nor do the third-party Nest modules it loads (@bull-board/nestjs, @nestjs/terminus, @nestjs/swagger, @nestjs/bullmq, @nestjs/event-emitter, @nestjs/typeorm, @nestjs/config).
waivers.evidence: apps/api/src/core/security/dependency-waiver-reachability.spec.ts fails if @Sse(, SSE_METADATA, SseStream or text/event-stream appears in apps/api/src; scan of third-party packages on 2026-09-30 found no occurrences.
waivers.closeCondition: Dedicated NestJS 10 -> 11 migration (@nestjs/core >= 11.1.18) with the full regression suite, before production; until then, any @Sse handler requires the migration (the reachability guard blocks CI).
